notes: Source = H.R. 617 Introduced-in-House (IH) text (4185 chars, read in full). The bill makes one substantive section (Sec. 2) of amendments to the Visit America Act: (a) adds new 605(b)(4) directing the Assistant Secretary of Commerce for Travel and Tourism to identify and domestically promote music-tourism locations/events; (b) strikes and re-inserts 605(d) with a parallel new (d)(4) for international music-tourism promotion (preserving pre-existing (d)(1) meetings/conferences, (d)(2) rural/cultural, (d)(3) sports/recreation); (c) adds new 605(f)(4) requiring a report to Senate Commerce and House Energy & Commerce within 1 year of enactment and every 2 years thereafter; (d) adds a statutory definition of 'music tourism' at 15 U.S.C. 9801(2). Every substantive prose claim (summary, brief, top_lines, sections, changes, gaps) is source-supported. NO MATERIAL ISSUES. Minor flags are all in likelihoodReason and are legislative-status/attribution facts (party/state R-TN & D-CA, 10 cosponsors, House passage, Senate calendar placement, low-cost/bipartisan characterizations, path-to-passage prediction) that are simply not present in the introduced-version source text — expected given the source doc, corroborated where possible by cache votes[]/versions[]; none distort bill content.
